type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type. Defaults to `about:blank`.

schema.description: A reusable workout template, created once and planned onto user calendars

anyOf.description: Environment a workout takes place in

pool_length_meters.description: Pool length in meters, for swim workouts

sport.description: Sport a workout template targets. Indoor/outdoor is expressed separately via environment.

items.description: A block of steps, repeated until its completion condition is met

completion_condition.description: When this block completes (e.g. repeat count via reps)

type.description: How a step or block is considered complete

value.description: Single value for the condition (e.g. seconds for time, meters for distance)

value_high.description: Upper bound when the condition is a range

value_low.description: Lower bound when the condition is a range

items.description: A single step within a step block

type.description: How a step or block is considered complete

value.description: Single value for the condition (e.g. seconds for time, meters for distance)

value_high.description: Upper bound when the condition is a range

value_low.description: Lower bound when the condition is a range

items.description: Equipment control applied during a step

type.description: Equipment control adjusted during a step (e.g. treadmill incline)

value.description: Control value (e.g. 0.02 for a 2% treadmill grade)

controls.description: Equipment controls applied during the step

items.description: Target intensity range for a step (e.g. heart-rate or power zone)

value_high.description: Upper bound of the target range

value_low.description: Lower bound of the target range

intensity_targets.description: Intensity targets to hold during the step

intensity_type.description: Intensity classification of a workout step

notes.description: Free-text coaching notes shown to the athlete

exercise_category.description: Garmin Training API exerciseCategory string (e.g. BENCH_PRESS, SQUAT)

anyOf.description: Weight display unit for strength exercises

items.description: Swim equipment used during a step

anyOf.description: Swim stroke for a swimming step

workout_id.description: Terra identifier of the stored template. Set by Terra in responses; ignored on create.
